import fluentqt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QVBoxLayout, QWidget
python.setup:
control = fluentqt.Accordion(%PARENT%)
def make_section(title, detail):
    item = fluentqt.Expander()
    item.setHeaderText(title)
    body = QWidget(item)
    body_layout = QVBoxLayout(body)
    body_layout.setContentsMargins(16, 12, 16, 14)
    body_layout.setSpacing(4)
    label = fluentqt.Label(detail, body)
    label.setWordWrap(True)
    body_layout.addWidget(label)
    item.setOwnedContentWidget(body)
    return item
general = make_section("Account", "Profile, sign-in, and recovery options.")
general.setExpandedAnimated(True, False)
control.addOwnedItem(general)
control.addOwnedItem(make_section("Privacy", "Diagnostics and telemetry permissions."))
